proposals: The Department of Commerce should check the FY2025-26 merchandise export total shown on the TIA Portal and publish an erratum if it is drawn from the wrong year, since its $451,070.0 million matches the FY2022-23 total digit for digit and sits 2.1% above TRADESTAT and PIB.

The Department of Commerce should publish a short reconciliation each year of TRADESTAT, TIA Portal and PIB press-release totals for exports, imports and the deficit, so that three official figures for one provisional year are explained by the publisher rather than by users.

The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade should publish PLI figures by scheme in separate columns for approved government outlay, actual disbursement, private investment committed and production targets, so that a ₹44,106 crore commitment is never read as a ₹6,322 crore outlay.

MoSPI should stamp every series in its data connector with the source vintage and last-updated date, so that a forex-reserves figure 13 months old is visibly flagged as stale rather than sitting beside current RBI data without warning.
